author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Hackers accessed some Booking.com user data, including names, emails, phone numbers, and booking details. The issue is now contained. Booking.com warned that hackers may have accessed customer data linked to travel reservations. Exposed details could include names, email addresses, phone numbers, and information shared with accommodations. Booking.com is one of the world’s leading online travel agencies […]
title: Hackers access Booking.com user data, company secures systems

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: An FBI case in Texas shows Signal messages can still be recovered from iPhones even after app uninstall, via system artifacts, challenging privacy assumptions. The recent revelations about FBI forensic access to Signal messages on an iPhone have reignited a long-standing misunderstanding about mobile privacy: the belief that disappearing messages and encrypted apps guarantee that […]
title: iPhone forensics expose Signal messages after app removal in U.S. case

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Citizen Lab reported that law enforcement used the surveillance tool Webloc to track up to 500M devices via ad data globally. title: Citizen Lab: Webloc tracked 500M devices for global law enforcement

title: Iran-linked group Handala claims to have breached three major UAE organizations

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Threat actors compromised the CPUID website and spread STX RAT through fake CPU-Z and HWMonitor downloads. Attackers breached the website CPUID and replaced download links for CPU-Z and HWMonitor with malicious files for several hours. Users who downloaded them got infected with the STX RAT, giving attackers remote access to their systems. The short attack […]
title: CPUID watering hole attack spreads STX RAT malware
